The '''rock-vulture''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Bird/Legends|bird]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Rots" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the [[Death/Legends|corpse]] of<ref name="Rots" /> the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]]<ref name="Unknown">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref> [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]&mdash;left lying on the landing platform where he was [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|killed]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]&mdash;was untouched by the local rock-[[Vulture/Legends|vultures]], who were apparently unable to [[Foodstuff/Legends|stomach]] him.<ref name="Rots" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rock-vultures were first mentioned in [[Matthew Stover]]'s [[2005]] [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Rots" />
